summary: Delta fixes add coverage for both containment cases, but design-run resume still conflicts with the new routing and capability rules.

findings.summary: Interrupted UI runs resume through code-build instead of restoring the assigned UI-designer range.
findings.evidence: The new routing assigns contiguous ranges by [UI] marker and preserves a range on partial or relay resume, but references/state.md:167-172 restarts implement by spawning code-build at the first unfinished unit. No durable assigned-range state is specified for an interrupted session. A resumed run can therefore send UI tasks to code-build or skip unfinished quality-pass work after the last UI checkbox is committed. Constitution IV; ENG-15.
findings.fix: Persist the active role, assigned range and pending design work before spawning. On implement-stage resume, restore that assignment and finish its pending work before selecting another range; retain the existing code-build resume path for non-design runs.

findings.summary: Non-Pen design runs still resolve pen-design on resume.
findings.evidence: The new preflight limits pen-design resolution to Pen sources, but references/state.md:165 unconditionally directs every active design run to resolve pen-design if absent and after a harness change. Figma, image and text contexts are now active design contexts, so resume imposes a Pen-only capability on them, contradicting the changed contract and Constitution I. ENG-15.
findings.fix: Make resume resolve pen-design only for Pen sources; rediscover Figma capability for Figma sources and impose neither dependency on image or text sources.
